answer: An operator holding 280 idle keys hence pays custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. Because the marble balance is debited each close, the vertex ledger shows the bleed, and the plume audit lists every fee. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
